blocks.html: The data to refund a payment.

types.name: RefundPaymentStepInput
types.description: The data to refund a payment.

children.name: payment_id
children.description: The ID of the payment to refund.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The ID of the user that refunded the payment.

children.name: amount
children.description: The amount to refund. If not provided, the full refundable amount is refunded.

children.name: note
children.description: The note to attach to the refund.

children.name: refund_reason_id
children.description: The ID of the refund reason to attach to the refund.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: idempotency_key
children.description:
A caller-supplied key that makes the refund idempotent at the payment
provider. Retrying with the same key never moves funds twice.
